The text also mentions that the Major League Baseball (MLB) team associated with the Dayton Dragons is the Cincinnati Reds. According to the table, the Cincinnati Reds are part of the National League (NL).

### Step 2: Determine if the league uses the designated hitter (DH) rule.
The text insight states that the National League (NL) does not use the designated hitter (DH) rule.

### Step 3: Check if pitchers take a turn at bat in the National League (NL).
Since the National League (NL) does not use the designated hitter (DH) rule, pitchers do not take a turn at bat in the NL.

Therefore, the answer to the question "In the league that has an eagle on the logo for the MLB team associated the Dayton Dragons, does the pitcher take a turn at bat?" is:

<answer>No, the pitcher does not take a turn at bat in the National League (NL).</answer>
